sample_unit: question-answer records from an online health platform
unlisted_practices: Augmenting generative answer generation with a neurosurgical knowledge graph and doctor features via hybrid attention
Multi-task learning jointly optimizing answer generation, candidate answer ranking, and doctor recommendation

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a novel model architecture (MT-KGAG) combining LLMs with knowledge graphs and multi-task learning for neurosurgery QA on an online platform dataset. It tests an algorithmic architecture rather than an organizational deployment practice or operational safeguard.
